mapper.insert: INSERT INTO llm_call (purpose, model, prompt_version, latency_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_cny, status, error_code, created_at) VALUES (#{call.purpose}, #{call.model}, #{call.promptVersion}, #{call.latencyMs}, #{call.inputTokens}, #{call.outputTokens}, #{call.costCny}, #{call.status}, #{call.errorCode}, #{call.createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT model, prompt_version AS promptVersion FROM llm_call WHERE id IN #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(latency_ms), 0) AS latencyMs, SUM(cost_cny) AS costCny, SUM(CASE WHEN cost_cny IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpriced FROM llm_call WHERE id IN #{id}
